# Poisson Regression

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message=F, warning=F)
library(SportsAnalytics270)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(BradleyTerry2)
library(VGAM)
library(SportsAnalytics270)
```

## Poisson Regression

```{r}
nhl_games <- read.csv("../data/game.csv")
nhl_teams <- read.csv("../data/team_info.csv") %>%
  select(team_id, abbreviation)

nhl_games <- nhl_games %>%
  drop_na()

nhl_games <- nhl_games %>% 
  inner_join(nhl_teams, by = c("home_team_id" = "team_id")) %>%
  rename("home_team_abr" = abbreviation)

nhl_games <- nhl_games %>% 
  inner_join(nhl_teams, by = c("away_team_id" = "team_id")) %>%
  rename("away_team_abr" = abbreviation)

``` 

## Poisson Regression

Checking that the home and away goals follow a poisson distribution in nhl.
Home goals histogram

\tiny

```{r, fig.align="center", out.height="60%"}
ggplot(nhl_games, aes(x = home_goals)) +

  xlab("Number of goals") +
```


## Poisson Regression

Dividing into test and train data sets.

```{r}
nhl_games_train <- nhl_games %>% 
  filter(season != "20192020")

nhl_games_test <- nhl_games %>% 
  filter(season == "20192020")

```

## Poisson Regression

Data modification.

\tiny
```{r}
get_poisson_form <- function(train_nhl_bta, country){
  
  nhl_home <- train_nhl_bta %>% 
    group_by(home_team_abr) %>%
    mutate(TEAM = as.factor(home_team_abr), 
           OPPONENT = as.factor(away_team_abr), 
           GOAL = home_goals, 
           HOME = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(TEAM, OPPONENT, GOAL, HOME)
  
  nhl_away <- train_nhl_bta %>% 
    group_by(away_team_abr) %>%
    mutate(TEAM = as.factor(away_team_abr), 
           OPPONENT = as.factor(home_team_abr), 
           GOAL = away_goals, 
           HOME = 0) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(TEAM, OPPONENT, GOAL, HOME)
  
  return(rbind(nhl_home, nhl_away))
}

nhl_games_train_poisson <- get_poisson_form(nhl_games_train)
nhl_games_test_poisson <- get_poisson_form(nhl_games_test)
```

## Poisson Regression

Fitting a model.

```{r}
nhl_model_poisson <- glm(GOAL~TEAM+OPPONENT+HOME, data=nhl_games_train_poisson, family=poisson(link=log))
summary(nhl_model_poisson)
```

## Poisson Regression

Calculating RMSE as a prediction accuracy metric.

```{r}
nhl_games_test_poisson$P.G <- predict(nhl_model_poisson,
                                      nhl_games_test_poisson, type = "response")

predict(nhl_model_poisson,data.frame(TEAM = "BOS", OPPONENT = "ATL",
                                     HOME = 1, type = "response"))

sqrt(mean((nhl_games_test_poisson$GOAL - nhl_games_test_poisson$P.G)^2))
```

## Poisson Regression

Underestimated and overestimated teams.

```{r}
underestimated_nhl_poisson <- nhl_games_test_poisson %>%
  filter(GOAL < P.G)

overestimated_nhl_poisson <-nhl_games_test_poisson %>%
  filter(GOAL > P.G)
```

# Bradley-Terry Model

## Bradley-Terry Model

Data modification.

```{r}
nhl_games_bt <- nhl_games %>%
  filter(home_goals != away_goals) %>%
  mutate(home_wl = ifelse(home_goals > away_goals, 'W', 'L'))

team_levels <- unique(c(nhl_games_bt$home_team_abr, nhl_games_bt$away_team_abr))

nhl_games_bt <- nhl_games_bt %>% 
          select(season, home_team_abr, away_team_abr, home_wl) %>% 
          mutate(ht_w = ifelse(home_wl=="W",1,0),
                 at_w = ifelse(home_wl=="L",1,0),
                 home_team_abr = factor(home_team_abr, levels = team_levels),
                 away_team_abr = factor(away_team_abr, levels = team_levels))

```

## Bradley-Terry Model

Test and train datasets.

```{r}
train_nhl_bt <- nhl_games_bt  %>% 
        filter(season != "20192020") %>%
        group_by(home_team_abr, away_team_abr) %>% 
        summarise(ht=sum(ht_w), at=sum(at_w))
 
test_nhl_bt <- nhl_games_bt  %>% 
        filter(season == "20192020") %>%
        group_by(home_team_abr, away_team_abr) %>% 
        summarise(ht=sum(ht_w), at=sum(at_w)) %>%
        filter(home_team_abr %in% (train_nhl_bt$home_team_abr),
        away_team_abr %in% (train_nhl_bt$away_team_abr))


```

## Bradley-Terry Model

Fitting a model

```{r}
BT_Model <- BTm(cbind(ht,at), home_team_abr, away_team_abr, 
                data=train_nhl_bt, id="team_")
summary(BT_Model)
BT_Model$coefficients
```

## Bradley-Terry Model

Predicting on test dataset.

```{r}
test_nhl_bt$home_win <- predict(BT_Model, test_nhl_bt)
test_nhl_bt$away_win <- 1 - test_nhl_bt$home_win 
```

## Bradley-Terry Model

Plotting the abilities.

\tiny

```{r, fig.align="center", out.height="60%"}
abilities <- as.data.frame(BTabilities(BT_Model))
abilities$team <- rownames(abilities)
abilities <- abilities[order(abilities$ability, decreasing = T),]

ggplot(data=abilities, aes(x=reorder(team,ability), y = ability, fill =team))+ geom_bar(stat="identity") + coord_flip() + theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  labs(x="Teams", y="Ability to Win", title="Team vs Ability")
```

# Pythagorean Wins

## Pythagorean Wins

```{r}
data("nfl_st")
nfl_st <- nfl_st %>%
  group_by(Season) %>%
  mutate(Rank = 1:n())
```

## Pythagorean Wins

\tiny

```{r, fig.align="center", out.height="70%"}
nfl_st %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PD, y = Wpct)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) +
  labs(x = "POINTS DIFFERENCE", y = "WINNING PERCENTAGE") + 
  ggtitle("WINNING PERCENTAGE OVER PD FOR NFL")
```

## Pythagorean Wins

Correlation between the variables.

```{r}
cor.test(nfl_st$PD, nfl_st$Wpct)
```

## Pythagorean Wins

Fitting a model.

```{r}
nfl_st_reg <- nfl_st %>%
  filter(W!= 0, L != 0, PA != 0) %>%
  mutate(W = W + 0.5 * T, L = L + 0.5 * T, RATIO = PF / PA)

model <- lm(log(W/L)~0+log(RATIO), data=nfl_st_reg)
summary(model)
```

## Pythagorean Wins

Getting a value for k.

```{r}
k <- model$coefficients[1]
head(nfl_st <- nfl_st %>%
  mutate(PWPCT = ( PF ^ k / (PF ^ k + PA ^ k)), PW = (W + L + T) * PWPCT),5)
```

## Pythagorean Wins
\tiny

```{r, fig.align="center", out.height="70%"}
nfl_st %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PWPCT, Wpct)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth() +
  ggtitle("Predicted winning percentage vs actual winning percentage") +
  xlab("Predicted winning percentage") +
  ylab("Actual winning percentage")
```

# Elo Ratings

## Elo Ratings

Calculating elos for every season, with seasonal metrics

\tiny

```{r}
home_factor_nhl <- 50
k_nhl <- 6
starting_elos <- 1500

calculate_elos <- function(data, home_factor, k, starting_elos){
  relative_elos <- data.frame()
  final_elos <- data.frame()
  for (season in unique(nhl_games$season)){
  seasonal_data <- data %>% 
    filter(season == season)
  season_elos <- elo.run(score(home_goals, away_goals) ~
          adjust(home_team_abr, home_factor_nhl) + away_team_abr,
          data = seasonal_data, k = k,
          initial.elos = starting_elos
        )
  starting_elos <- final.elos(season_elos) * 0.8
  relative_elos <- rbind(relative_elos,
                            data.frame(season_elos, season = season))
  final_elos_df <- data.frame(season = season, 
                              team_abr = names(starting_elos), 
                              elo = starting_elos)
  final_elos <- rbind(final_elos, final_elos_df)
  }
  return (list(final_elos=final_elos, relative_elos=relative_elos))
}

nhl_relative_elos <- calculate_elos(nhl_games, home_factor_nhl, k_nhl, 
                                    starting_elos)$relative_elos

nhl_final <- calculate_elos(nhl_games, home_factor_nhl, k_nhl, starting_elos)$final_elos
nhl_relative_elos$Predicted <- ifelse(nhl_relative_elos$p.A > 0.5, 1,0)
```

## Elo Ratings

Checking predictive power.

\tiny

```{r}
calculate_brier <- function(data){
  diff <- data$p.A - data$wins.A
  accuracy <- sum(diff^2) / nrow(data)
  return(accuracy)
}

(caret::confusionMatrix(data = factor(nhl_relative_elos$Predicted), 
                       reference = factor(nhl_relative_elos$wins.A)))

(calculate_brier(nhl_relative_elos))
```

## Elo Ratings

Trying to play with k parameter to improve the accuracy.

```{r}
nhl_k_picker <- function(data = nhl_games){
  result <- c()
  for( k in seq(4,12,1)){
    elos_for_k <- calculate_elos(data = data, 
                                 home_factor_nhl,
                                 k,
                                 1500)
    
    br_scores <- elos_for_k$relative_elos %>%
      group_by(season) %>%
      summarise(br.score = sum((p.A - wins.A)^2) / n(),
                k = k)
    result <- rbind(result, br_scores)
  }
  model <- lm( br.score ~ 0 + k, data = result )
  return( list(model = model,
               df = as.data.frame(result)) )
}
```


## Elo Ratings

```{r}
k_list <- nhl_k_picker()

k_model <- k_list$model
k_df <- k_list$df
summary(k_model)
```

## Elo Ratings


```{r}
k_df %>% 
  group_by(season) %>%
  filter(br.score == min(br.score)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pull(k)

```

## Elo Ratings
\tiny

```{r, fig.align="center", out.height="60%"}
k_df <- k_df %>%
  group_by(k) %>%
  summarize(br.score = mean(br.score))

ggplot(k_df, aes(x = k, y = br.score) ) + 
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Predictions accuracy using brier score vs k value") +
  xlab("K value") + 
  ylab("Brier score")

```
